human_pressure.one_screen_brief: Make time an explicit governance dimension without building a workflow engine: later policy/context evidence must not silently rewrite earlier attribution; authority, approval, and budget evidence must remain tied to the execution scope and evidence time they govern.
human_pressure.why_now: Long-running agent executions can remain active while policy, approval, or budget context changes. The boundary needs deterministic temporal semantics before realtime decision APIs exist.
do_not_misread: Do not build a scheduler, state machine, or live revalidation service.
Do not add an HTTP decision API.
Do not guess validity intervals that evidence does not provide.
red_lines: No retroactive mutation of historical facts.

machine_core.goal: Add minimal deterministic temporal-attribution checks and tests using existing timestamps, scope_ref, context refs, and evidence refs.
red_lines: Do not invent effective_from/effective_to unless current contracts provide them.
Do not rewrite earlier projection state with later context.
Do not make unknown temporal coverage clean.
Do not introduce a new BLOCKED or HUMAN_REVIEW path unless existing required-evidence semantics already demand it.
invariants: Earlier evidence keeps the governance context attributable at its own evidence time.
Later policy_snapshot_ref does not back-apply to earlier actions.
Scoped authority/approval/budget evidence must not silently govern a different scope.
Missing temporal evidence remains unknown rather than inferred.
Replay of the same ordered evidence yields the same temporal attribution.

observable_effect.assertion: Historical governance attribution is stable under later context changes and replay.

proofs.assertion: Focused tests cover policy snapshot change, scope separation, replay determinism, and missing temporal evidence.

failure_semantics: Ambiguous temporal attribution remains unknown/inconsistent rather than guessed.
Conflicting context is surfaced through existing inconsistency mechanisms, not overwritten.

steps.title: Define temporal attribution from existing evidence
details: Use existing event timestamps and explicit context/scope refs only.

steps.title: Prevent retroactive rewriting
details: Ensure later context evidence cannot silently mutate earlier governance attribution.

steps.title: Protect cross-scope constraints
details: Ensure temporal ordering does not make one scope's authority/approval/budget apply to another scope.

steps.title: Prove replay determinism
details: Replay identical evidence and assert identical attribution/outcome behavior.

acceptance: Later policy/context evidence does not rewrite earlier attribution.
No live revalidation service is introduced.

must_check: Only existing timestamps and explicit refs drive temporal semantics.
Historical attribution is immutable under later context changes.
No realtime API/scheduler/workflow engine is added.
reject_if: Later context overwrites earlier evidence attribution.
A live revalidation service or write API appears.
Unknown is promoted to clean due to missing time evidence.

validation_notes.targeted_contract_coverage: A dedicated temporal test plus existing projection/rebuild suites prove attribution without broad runtime changes.
validation_notes.completion_reason: The test file is explicitly created by this pack before validation.
